_comment: Copy to settings.json and run: USBPrepTool.ps1 -NoGui -ConfigPath settings.json
Only DiskNumber and IsoPath are required. Everything else falls back to a
default, and RaidSetId defaults to whatever hardware detection picked on the
machine running the build - which is the right answer when the tool is run on
DiskNumber must match Get-Disk output. The tool still refuses any disk that is
not USB, or that is the boot or system disk, regardless of what is set here.
null (deliberately no bundled RAID driver). Note null and 'auto' differ:
null means load nothing, 'auto' means let detection decide.
Only the chosen set is auto-loaded in WinPE; the others go to Drivers\All for
manual F6 use, because all three claim the same hardware IDs.
